alex-m: deploybot blocked prod publish — ECR rejected tag 'service:release-20240320' (digest mismatch). deploybot prevented rollout to prod-eu.
ci-bot: [CI] build 20240320-78 finished. pushed to staging-eu with digest sha256:abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890abcd1234ef567890.
ci-bot: attempted push to prod account failed: Repository already exists with different manifest. HTTP 409.
mira-eng: I pulled both manifests — staging is sha256:abcd1234... , prod attempted push was sha256:efgh5678... so contents differ.
sara-ops: who rotated prod registry creds last? cross-account replication normally keeps tags in sync but we have immutability on prod ECR.
dinesh-release: confirmed: prod registry has 'immutable-tags = true' for prod repos. That prevents overwriting an existing tag, which is why push failed.
alex-m: options: 1) pin service to the existing prod digest (rollback), 2) retag new digest under a different tag and republish, or 3) delete tag in prod and allow retag (not allowed under immutability).
deploybot: AUTOMATION: publish halted at 1711123456 due to tag conflict. No automatic retag performed.
mira-eng: quick forensic: CI job that targeted prod included a small dockerfile change (base image bump). That likely produced efgh5678. Staging pipeline used the previous base.
sara-ops: ops preference: avoid manual tag deletes or cross-account retags during open change windows. Safer to rollback canary to the prior digest and then republish as a new patch tag.
dinesh-release: rollback plan: trigger deploybot job rollback/canary-abort -> pin services/service to digest sha256:abcd1234... across prod-eu ASGs -> run health checks -> then schedule republish with new tag v1.4.2-hotfix.
alex-m: i'll draft a tiny release note: "hotfix: republish artifact with stable digest; avoid overwriting immutable tag" and file a change-window exception if needed.
mira-eng: also: cosign verify on the staging artifact (sha256:abcd1234...) returned "signature: OK". The attempted prod digest efgh5678 has no cosign signature in the artifact store.
sara-ops: that suggests the prod push used a rebuilt artifact instead of the canonical s3 artifact. We must republish from the canonical CI artifact to ensure reproducibility. No retagging.
alex-m: can someone kick the rollback? i'll be in a meeting in ~10.
dinesh-release: i'm on it. kicking rollback now. pinging @oncall-bot to create an incident note.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20240320-24. Rollback started by dinesh-release at 1711123600.
ci-bot: created republish pipeline run 20240320-78-hotfix. Artifact source: s3://ci-artifacts/service/20240320-78.tar.gz. Expected digest after rebuild: sha256:abcd1234...
mira-eng: after rollback completes, i'll run cosign verify + digest check in a dry-run in the prod account before any manual approve for republish. Command I'll run: ```cosign verify --key k8s://projects/_/secrets/cosign-key s3://ci-artifacts/...```
sara-ops: thanks. once dry-run green, require manual approval from security for cross-account push. ops will not allow automatic cross-account overwrite.
alex-m: thanks team — keep updates here. :thumbsup:
